desc:
👍 NEW CODE AT 500 LIKES! Like the game to help unlock it!

Welcome to Card Origins, an anime-inspired card collecting RPG where your next pull could change everything

🌟 Collect rare cards featuring your favorite characters
⚔️ Build your team of 4 and combine unique abilities to defeat powerful enemies
🌍 Explore different worlds and challenge bosses
🗼 Conquer the Tower, brave the Dungeon, and enter the Colosseum
💎 Unlock stunning borders and strengthen your cards with traits, relics, and ascension
🍀 Boost your luck and chase your next legendary pull

Every card brings new possibilities, every team has a different strategy

⭐ Favorite the game and join our community for updates, codes, and sneak peeks!
